0022600142.text: The Mavericks come in at 1-2 (0-1 at home) on a one-game losing streak, sitting 12th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, while the Thunder are 3-0 on a three-game winning streak, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West. Dallas will be without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Mavericks lost 0-3 to the Thunder in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
